name: Czechigram API
description:
Instagram-like photo sharing application API with multi-tenant architecture.

## Authentication
Most endpoints require JWT authentication via Bearer token in the Authorization header.
Obtain a token by registering or logging in.

## Multi-tenant Architecture
The base URL includes a `{student}` parameter representing the student instance.
Each student has an isolated database schema. Configure the student name in the server URL.
